text:
If you're still out enjoying that sun, hang on to it a little longer, because tonight's about as easy as it gets. We're partly cloudy and comfortable behind sunset, dropping toward a low around 69 with just a light south breeze. The lake's calm too, one to two foot waves and water sitting at a swimmable 77, so a late paddle or a lakeside dinner is a fine call tonight.

Tomorrow's a different animal. It'll start mostly sunny and warm, pushing toward 89 with the heat index closer to mid-90s, but the afternoon brings scattered showers and thunderstorms as deep moisture and some instability move in. The American model wants it hotter and drier, the European model is much wetter and cooler, so there's real uncertainty in how it plays out, but I'd trust the wetter lean given how humid it'll feel building into it. Get outdoor plans done by early afternoon and keep an eye to the sky after that, especially if you're out on the water.

week.blurb: Mostly sunny and comfortable with a high near 86, easily the pick of the week.
Sunny, steamy morning gives way to afternoon storms, high near 89 but the models can't agree how wet it gets.
More clouds than sun with a high near 88 and storms building through the afternoon into a wetter night.
Soggy Saturday, showers and thunderstorms likely most of the day with a high near 86.
Relief arrives, mostly sunny, drier air, and a comfortable high near 86 with only a slim shower risk early.
Another pleasant day to start, high near 85, before afternoon storm chances creep back in.
A cold front brings scattered storms and a cooler high near 82, with drier air trending in behind it.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: High pressure off the East Coast begins to weaken and suppress southward Sunday into Monday, allowing a more westerly breeze to usher in noticeable relief from the humidity. Sunday will feature mostly sunny skies with highs in the mid-80s and only an isolated shower risk over the Northeast Kingdom. Clear to partly cloudy conditions continue Monday with highs in the lower 80s and comfortable humidity levels. Our next weather feature arrives late Monday night into Tuesday as a cold front sweeps through the region, bringing widespread showers and thunderstorms. Drier, cooler, and refreshing air builds behind the front for next Wednesday.
